source.title: Some open problems on fixed point properties related to locally compact groups and semigroups

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as the zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL https://zbmath.org/7943986 with trailing identifier 7943986.

Local workflow resolver rows in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-1.csv and outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identify the exact zbMATH record title as 'Some open problems on fixed point properties related to locally compact groups and semigroups' and year 2019, but provide no full-text link.

Failure modes: network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches of zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org; blocked_or_challenged or unreadable resolver output for the zbMATH web page; metadata_only for generic zbMATH search/help pages; and terms-gated metadata-only access for REST/OAI API roots. No readable PDF or HTML full-text artifact for the exact record was recovered.

Ran exact-work recovery searches using the zbMATH identifier, the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus DOI, and the title with likely author terms. Search results produced unrelated numeric matches, generic zbMATH documentation, related but different fixed-point papers, or citation/search snippets. Candidate pages such as 'Fixed point properties for semigroups of nonlinear mappings on unbounded sets' and 'Amenability properties and fixed point properties of affine representations of semigroups' were rejected because their visible titles and years did not confirm the same exact source as the zbMATH record title.
